name: Pagination
description: Controls for moving between the pages of a long table or list: previous, next and page numbers. On phones it shrinks to the essentials.

classes.ayy-pagination--sm: Small links: a step under the sm control height, text a pixel smaller.
classes.ayy-pagination--lg: Large links: the md control height and md text.
classes.ayy-pagination__link: A page: <a href> when pages have URLs, <button> otherwise. aria-current="page" marks the current one (outlined tint, heavier). aria-disabled="true" (a link without href) or disabled dims an end you can't go past.
classes.ayy-pagination__size: Optional page size picker: a <div> holding a <label> and a small Select. Goes first in the <nav>.
classes.ayy-pagination__size-label: The picker's <label for>, "Rows per page". Visually hidden below 48rem, still the select's name.
classes.ayy-pagination__link--step: Previous / next, with an arrow Icon (directional) and a word. Stays visible on phones, where the numbers hide.

default.looks: Muted pill links at the sm control height, in tabular figures; previous and next carry an arrow and a word.

disabled.when: :disabled or [aria-disabled="true"] (a link without href at the first or last page)
disabled.looks: --ayy-opacity-disabled, ignores the pointer. Forced colours: GrayText.

selected.looks: Line-strong border, wash-hover fill, text colour, semibold. Forced colours: Highlight.

loading.none: Show the loading in the list or table it pages (Skeleton rows), not here.

scale.sm: Links the sm control height minus 4px (24px compact, 28 comfortable, 36 touch), sm control text minus 1px.
scale.md: Links the sm control height (28px compact, 32 comfortable, 40 touch), sm control text.
scale.lg: Links the md control height (32px compact, 40 comfortable, 44 touch), md control text. The page size picker steps up with it.

sizes.density: Every size follows data-density with the control scale.
sizes.width: Hugs its links and wraps. Below 48rem only previous, the current page and next show.

js: paginationClass, paginationEllipsisClass, paginationSizeClass, paginationSizeLabelClass constants; paginationRootSizeClass(size?) → string | undefined (the --sm / --lg class for the <nav>; md adds nothing; paginationSizeClass is the page size picker); paginationLinkClass({ step?, className? }) → string; paginationRange(page, count, siblings = 1) → (number | "…")[] — which pages to show, always the same number of slots.

Pagination.renders: <nav class="ayy-pagination"> with previous, pages from paginationRange() and next

props.size: "sm" | "md" | "lg" — the height of the links and the size of their text.
props.siblings: Pages either side of the current one. Default 1.
props.onPageChange: (page) => void — without href, pages become buttons; with it, links still work and the handler runs instead of navigating.
props.pageSize: How many items a page holds. Shows the picker when onPageSizeChange is also set.
props.pageSizeOptions: number[] — the sizes the picker offers. Default [10, 25, 50]; pageSize is added if missing.
props.onPageSizeChange: (pageSize) => void — set the size and go back to page 1.
props.labels: { nav?, previous?, next?, pageSize? } — text for translation. Defaults "Pagination", "Previous", "Next", "Rows per page".

a11y: It's a <nav aria-label="Pagination">: give a second one on the page a different label.
The current page has aria-current="page"; it's outlined and bolder as well as tinted.
Previous and next say so in words; their arrows are decorative and mirror in right-to-left text.
An end you can't go past is aria-disabled (or disabled): screen readers hear it's unavailable.
After a page change in place, move focus to the top of the updated table or list, or announce the new range.
do: Use pagination under a table or list that has more rows than fit, when people need to reach a specific page or share its URL.
Give pages URLs (href) when you can, so back and reload work.
Offer a page size picker (pageSize, onPageSizeChange) on long tables so people choose how much they scan.
Show the range next to it ("41–60 of 1,280") in muted text.
dont: Don't use pagination for a feed people only scroll through — load more as they scroll, or add a Load more button.
Don't use it to step through a sign-up or checkout — use Steps.
Don't show it when everything fits on one page.
